execution_readiness.reason: Explicit approval and a reviewed contract-freeze checkpoint are required before held-out execution.

claim.statement: For this pinned Qwen2.5-14B repository-agent workload on vLLM 0.34.0 and L40S GPUs, online FP8 reduces successful paired workflow latency without more than a 5 percentage-point task-success regression.
claim.boundary: One pinned checkpoint, one two-call bounded repository-search workflow, two balanced task families, vLLM 0.34.0, and L40S hardware. No general model-quality, throughput, concurrency, routing, or production-behavior claim.

intervention.hardware: two L40S GPUs in one Modal container, one profile per GPU
intervention.baseline: BF16 weights and activations; quantization unset
intervention.candidate: vLLM online fp8_per_tensor; FP8 E4M3 per-tensor weights and dynamic activations
startup_assertions: no candidate activation-quantization fallback is present

proposed_sample.source: A deterministic balanced selection from the untouched 240-task draft pool; raw tasks and answers remain private.

primary_latency.population: task pairs where both variants succeed
primary_latency.decision: superiority passes only when the upper confidence bound is below 0 ms

paired_task_success.method: exact marginal binomial bounds with Bonferroni coverage
paired_task_success.decision: candidate-minus-baseline one-sided lower bound must be at least -0.05

sample_size_plan.selection_rationale: The larger fixed sample preserves 90 tasks per family and is driven by quality-gate feasibility, not by the large calibration latency effect.

include: exactly one attempt for every proposed task and variant
all complete attempts in absolute task-success and completion gates
only both-successful task pairs in the primary latency estimand
exclude_from_latency_only: task pairs where either variant fails the deterministic evaluator
inclusion_and_exclusion.failure_treatment: Task, model-output, timeout, evaluator, and infrastructure failures remain failures or invalid evidence under their declared gate; they are never converted to zero latency or silently dropped.

validity_requirements: dataset and evaluator hashes match this proposal
all proposed task IDs are unique and present for both variants
the complete paired DAG, attempt artifacts, backend identities, and evaluator evidence are present
model, revision, tokenizer, chat template, software, hardware, generation, tool, evaluator, seed, and ordering controls match the frozen contract
no unexpected retry, replacement, partial rerun, or second held-out execution occurs
missing_evidence_rule: Missing, mutated, incomplete, duplicated, or identity-mismatched evidence makes the corresponding claim invalid or unknown; it is not imputed as success, failure-free latency, or zero.

stopping_and_rerun_rules.sample: fixed at 180 pairs if this proposal is approved and frozen

outcome_paths: verified latency superiority with both quality gates passing

approval_boundary.next_action: Obtain explicit user approval of this proposal before changing either freeze declaration or enabling any held-out runner.
